calibration_reference: real server paces each response at `rate`; 1MiB@512KiB/s ~2.05s (frozen)

dynamics.loss: per-request failure probability rising with concurrency (congestion); one retransmission modeled
dynamics.per_request: latency + per-extra-connection overhead + chunk/(effective per-response rate)
dynamics.phases: 1-3 within-episode phases with randomized wall-clock transition times
dynamics.shared_cap: optional link_bandwidth caps the aggregate; extra concurrency then stops helping
dynamics.step: one RL step completes decision_interval requests; reward=-interval wall-clock seconds
dynamics.workers: concurrency workers run continuously; interval elapsed = sum(service_times)/active_workers

label: concurrency-focused training simulator v5 (training-only; state spec v2)
